text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup begins—

"A clash between Triple Crown Umamusume— 
in the long history of the racing world, 
such a thing had never materialized until 
very recently."

To begin with, winning the Triple Crown is 
such a historic feat that having Triple 
Crown Umamusume appear in the same era was 
nothing short of a dream.

However, with the emergence of Mr. C.B. 
and Symboli Rudolf, people witnessed a 
historic clash between two Triple Crown 
Umamusume.

And today—in the history of Triple Crown 
Umamusume clashes, the first-ever Triple 
Tiara Umamusume etches her name.

A race of the century capturing the entire 
world's attention... An extraordinary 
atmosphere hung over the venue.
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Such incredible heat. ...I wonder what 
kind of race is waiting for us—

The thunderous cheers echo all the way 
here. That exhilarating thrill must surely 
resonate in Mejiro Ramonu's heart as well.

Even so, she meticulously, carefully... 
inspected her own body, just as she always 
did.

"I don't say it out loud because I know 
she doesn't need it. To quietly send her 
off to the battle of the century— that is 
my job for today."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, today is going to be a 
sublime race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"If I achieve victory, I will be able 
to... offer up a wonderful love."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
No, I will offer it. I've gathered all the 
necessary elements, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: So, may I have it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The crowd, the atmosphere, the racetrack, 
the rivals, and myself... Everything is in 
absolute perfection.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"To finish it off, we add you, and we're 
all done. Isn't that right, Trainer?"

In the scenery she sees—in the races she 
loves, I am included too. Even without 
words, I could feel the depth of her 
sentiment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I know.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: âRudolf, it's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"To think I get to compete with you on the 
turf again... I suppose I owe Ramonu my 
thanks."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to return the favor for what 
happened back then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As long as I challenge this as the 
"Emperor," I have no intention of losing 
to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "To you—and, of course, to her as well."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ramonu!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ramonu...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Please stop.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You two, I don't need any more than that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Because it would be terribly tasteless, 
wouldn't it? To confine true feelings 
within mere words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You may throw it all at me, just as it 
overflows, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Even with the two of them combined... 
they still can't match my love."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... What a wonderful look on your 
face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Cast aside any sense of leeway. 
Otherwise, you'll never surpass your past 
self."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Go right ahead... desire it, crave it. 
Try and take it from me, if you can."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —I'll take good care of you.
